conditions.block_note: block size does not change output (324/324 and 648/648 block-parity groups in earlier suites); timing is T5

targets.metric: 1-8 kHz 2 ms RMS attack peak lag, output minus input (PR100 scorer), max over counted events
targets.applies_to: all shifts; inputs whose own attack peaks all sit within 10 ms of their events; only events with event SNR >= event_snr_min_db
targets.event_snr: peak of the 1-8 kHz 2 ms RMS envelope within 10 ms after the event over its maximum 20-3 ms before the event (Tools/TransposeNext/attack_snr.py)

targets.metric: same lag as T1 for events with event SNR < event_snr_min_db in the same inputs
targets.note: not a timing gate: the peak search cannot locate an event this close to the band floor. Detection of these events stays in T4 (missed events, false resets)

targets.metric: per-note 120 Hz low-pass energy centroid, output minus input, max over notes
targets.applies_to: short notes (riffs, holdout plucks) and long notes (80 ms decay)

targets.bound: time-domain upshift must jump back a whole period T; period-aligned splices measured 19-21 ms for B0/A0 long notes
targets.ceiling_rule: first full run of corr40-split-rt (this spec version) plus 1.0 ms, rounded up to 0.5 ms; not a quality target

targets.metric: steady tones: warble p95-p5 and dominant error; all inputs: onset association within 10 ms; low-band resets beyond startup on markers/guards/sustain

targets.note: real DI recordings, listening, Windows/macOS DAW acceptance, fixed PDC contract, product engine integration
